headword: {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}

definitions.explanation: News coverage or an interview obtained by a single media outlet with no access granted to competitors. A common selling point on magazine covers and in TV news promotion, signaling that the content cannot be seen or read elsewhere.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}です。
⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We conducted an exclusive interview with the famous director.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週刊|しゅうかん}{誌|し}→週刊誌：11179_shuukanshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{当事者|とうじしゃ}→当事者：12504_toujisha⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧し、⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The weekly magazine landed an exclusive interview with the person at the center of the incident and drew a lot of attention.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{独占|どくせん}→独占：13494_dokusen⟧ ('monopoly; exclusive possession') + ⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧ ('news gathering, reporting; interview'). Widely used by newspapers, TV news programs, and weekly magazines to promote content that cannot be found in competing outlets.

Can function grammatically as both a noun and a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to get an exclusive interview').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧: to succeed in getting an exclusive
- {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct an exclusive interview
- {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to grant an exclusive interview
- {独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧: exclusive footage
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}: urgent exclusive interview

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧: news gathering; reporting; interview (the general term)
- ⟦{独占|どくせん}→独占：13494_dokusen⟧: monopoly; exclusive control
- スクープ: scoop — an exclusive story, especially a surprising one
- ⟦{独占|どくせん}→独占：13494_dokusen⟧⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧: exclusive broadcast
- ⟦{独占|どくせん}→独占：13494_dokusen⟧⟦{配信|はいしん}→配信：04898_haishin⟧: exclusive streaming/distribution
- ⟦{会見|かいけん}→会見：11447_kaiken⟧: press conference — contrasts with an exclusive in that many outlets attend

USAGE:
Strongly associated with media and journalism. On magazine covers it often appears as a large headline: 「{独占|どくせん}{取材|しゅざい}!」
